Documentary evidence simply put

______ means oral or written statement made by a person in court as proof of the truth of that which is being stated or asserted, it could be direct evidence or hearsay.
Testimony
Testimony means oral or written statement made by a person in court as proof of the truth of that which is being stated or asserted, it could be direct evidence or hearsay.
______ is a document which embodies all the rules, regulation and directions for the operations of the government of a given society in relation with its citizenry generally.
written constitution
A written constitution is a document which embodies all the rules, regulation and directions for the operations of the government of a given society in relation with its citizenry generally.
______ is a written admission made before or at the proceedings, and admissible at subsequent criminal proceedings relating to the same matter.
informal admission
An informal admission is a written admission made before or at the proceedings, and admissible at subsequent criminal proceedings relating to the same matter.
______ is a question of law not logic.
Admission
Admission is a question of law not logic.
______ are the events of things to be proved upon which the rule of law is applied.
Facts
Facts are the events of things to be proved upon which the rule of law is applied.
______ is an acceptance by court of the truth of a fact without proof on the ground that it is within the court's own knowledge or not being out of professional knowledge of the judge himself.
Judicial notice

Judicial notice is an acceptance by court of the truth of a fact without proof on the ground that it is within the court's own knowledge or not being out of professional knowledge of the judge himself.

Res gestae

______ is a statement of personal knowledge or observations, which tends to prove a fact without inference or presumption.
Direct evidence

ancient document
